policy.scope: Navigation only, including existing dynamic 2D identify/locate records. Question kinds and content are unchanged.
policy.fallback: An unmapped question remains available under all questions / review mapping needed.
policy.uncertainty: uncertain=true with a non-null section means a usable suggested landing section, not a verified precise mapping. Null section means no defensible current review target.
policy.dynamicQuestions: Only dynamic_anatomy_3d is excluded. Dynamic 2D questions retain their kind and original interaction; this sidecar does not turn them into multiple-choice questions.
policy.liveEligibility: Mirrors current source verified status plus includeAdvancedAnatomyPractice. Retired IDs remain in this audit map with livePractice=false.
